sections: Considerations when cloning objects with prototypes, classes, and accessors
findings: resourceLimits exclude external data/ArrayBuffers; global OOM may abort process
parent command-line old/semi-space arguments can override heap options; Worker execArgv disallows V8 flags
terminate returns Promise fulfilled upon exit; no stated hard scheduling/preemption bound
structured clone does not retain original object/prototype/error identity; provider must preserve parent reasons outside transport
sync wait suspends the agent; notification or timeout resumes it
DoWait compares expected value under waiter-list critical section; finite timeout includes implementation-defined additionalTimeout
application payload ownership and cancellation races still require a correct atomic protocol
blocking permission is host-specific; native Node Worker qualification remains necessary
explicit exit may abandon pending asynchronous work/output; exitCode is not itself explicit exit
L modeled-exit ownership/drain policy is a declared difference, not full Node parity
